Product Features

  • LED headboard in the shape of a pouf: The headboard in the shape of a pouf is the perfect accessory in any bedroom and brings the sleeping area to life. The beige colour matches a variety of interior styles. The height of the bed is adjustable.
  • Chic and Cozy Ambiance: Enjoy the soft glow of the LED ambient lighting that gracefully frames the contours of the headboard, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxing. Unlike traditional LEDs, this bed is equipped with LEDs that can receive a wider range of signals, with a light strip that changes color and a music mode that enriches the sleeping experience.
  • Skin-friendly material: Fully upholstered in linen, the beige bed is a fantastic addition that is comfortable to the touch. The padded headboard provides a comfortable place to rest in bed.
  • Rugged craftsmanship: Crafted with precision and durability in mind, the bed features a sturdy structure that guarantees stability and longevity. Our attention to detail ensures a reliable and secure foundation that supports you in style and substance.
  • Efficient Assembly: The LED bed comes flat-packed and can be assembled by yourself. DIYers don't need to worry because the innovative design makes it easy to set up, especially when coupled with the clear and comprehensive instructions that come with every purchase and are also available online.
